name: aisa-gtm
description: GTM intelligence and marketing workflows powered by AIsa.

interface.shortDescription: Research markets, customers, prospects and websites, then turn evidence into GTM decisions and outreach drafts.
interface.longDescription: AIsa MCP powered GTM research, customer insight, B2B prospecting, content strategy, creator marketing, SEO audit, AI search visibility and evidence-grounded cold-email drafting workflows.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare a brand with three competitors. Ask for the brand and competitor websites, then assess positioning, pricing and customer proof.
Help me analyze customer interviews and reviews. Ask me to share the source material, then identify needs, buying triggers and objections with cited quotes.
Help me find 10 B2B prospects. Ask for my ideal customer profile and target market, then rank companies by fit and show the evidence and gaps.
Help me choose 3–5 creators. Ask for the brand, target audience, market, budget and any existing proposals, then plan a measurable pilot.
Help me build a 90-day content roadmap. Ask for my business goals, target audience and any customer, keyword or existing-content data first.
Help me audit a website for SEO. Ask for its URL and target market, then inspect key pages and prioritize technical and on-page fixes.
Help me draft a cold email and three follow-ups. Ask for the recipient, value proposition and supporting proof, then prepare drafts for review.
Help me assess AI search visibility. Ask for the brand, website, market and sample questions, then examine mentions and citations and recommend improvements.
